categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and adds libFuzzer custom mutator dispatch to the fuzz harness framework alongside a PSBT mutator in src/test/fuzz/.
categories.rationale: Enables deep fuzz testing for PSBT parsing and introduces target-specific custom mutator support to the fuzz harness framework. As noted in the PR description, byte-level mutations rarely produce valid key-value maps and cryptographic keydata, causing inputs to be rejected early and leaving deeper per-field parsing logic unexercised.
